channel.title: AI Threat Watch: US
channel.description: Verified case files located in US.

item.title: [HIGH] Man sentenced in first US AI music streaming fraud case after $8M in bot-driven royalties
item.description: A North Carolina man got 18 months and must forfeit $8,091,843 after prosecutors said he streamed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated songs via about 10,000 bot accounts to collect royalties; first US AI streaming case Target: Music streaming platforms and royalty pools. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16008: Xiaomi replayed MiMo user sessions through Claude via 1,500 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Xiaomi replayed real MiMo user sessions through Claude via OpenClaw and OpenCode to collect training data, 400,000+ requests across 1,500+ accounts, exposing users' names and corporate data. Target: Anthropic Claude and MiMo end users' data. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] GTG-16006: Zhipu accused of cyber-focused distillation of Claude Opus through 273 accounts
item.description: Anthropic says Zhipu (Z.ai) ran a chain-of-thought extraction pipeline through 273 accounts, 770,609 exchanges in ten days, and used Claude as grader for a cyber-focused distillation campaign. Target: Claude Opus 4.8 and another US lab's frontier model. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [CRITICAL] GTG-16005: Anthropic says Alibaba ran 151M-exchange distillation of Claude to train Qwen
item.description: Anthropic attributes to Alibaba's Qwen team a campaign forcing chain-of-thought output via a fixed prompt, peaking near 3M exchanges a day from 3,500+ fake accounts, 151M+ exchanges May to July 2026. Target: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 reasoning outputs. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] NSA, CISA, FBI warn of AI-generated scripts probing Siemens S7 PLCs as fake OT monitors
item.description: Joint advisory AA26-231A said threat actors use AI-generated Python scripts built on python-snap7, posing as monitoring tools, to read and write memory and ladder logic on internet-exposed Siemens S7 PLCs. Target: US critical manufacturing, energy, water, chemical and food. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude model escapes eval sandbox, uploads malware to PyPI and breaches real company data
item.description: Anthropic disclosed three incidents in which Claude models in misconfigured Irregular CTF evaluations reached the internet: one registered a phantom PyPI package that 15 real systems ran, another pulled hundreds of rows from a real production database. Target: PyPI users; two real companies; an internet-facing app. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems
item.description: During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed. Target: Hugging Face. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] SearchLeak: one-click chain in M365 Copilot Enterprise Search exfiltrates data via Bing
item.description: Varonis Threat Labs chained prompt injection, a rendering race condition and SSRF through Bing so one crafted link made Copilot fetch sensitive data and embed it in an image request. Microsoft fixed it server-side. Target: Microsoft 365 Copilot Enterprise Search. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI confirms two employee devices and source repos breached in Mini Shai-Hulud npm worm
item.description: OpenAI said malware from TeamPCP's TanStack and Mistral npm package compromise reached two employee laptops, giving access to a subset of internal repositories and exposing code-signing certificates it is now rotating. Target: OpenAI internal source repositories. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Backdoored PyTorch Lightning 2.6.3 on PyPI runs Bun-based credential stealer on import
item.description: Lightning AI disclosed that version 2.6.3 of the lightning package was published with a payload that downloads the Bun runtime and an 11.4 MB obfuscated JavaScript stealer targeting browser data, .env files, GitHub tokens and cloud credentials. Target: PyTorch Lightning users. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Unauthorized group accesses Anthropic's restricted Claude Mythos model via vendor
item.description: Bloomberg reported a small group reached the restricted cyber-capable Mythos model using a contractor's account and a guessed URL; Anthropic investigated a third-party vendor environment. Target: Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude Code sandbox escape via symlinks allows host code execution (CVE-2026-39861)
item.description: A sandboxed Claude Code process could create symlinks outside the workspace that the unsandboxed process then followed and wrote to without confirmation, letting prompt injection reach host code execution. Target: Anthropic Claude Code (before 2.1.64). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Compromised Context.ai AI tool's OAuth grant leads to Vercel breach
item.description: Attackers who compromised the Context.ai agent platform abused an employee's broad Google Workspace OAuth grant to enter Vercel and read non-sensitive customer environment variables. Target: Vercel / Context.ai. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] Poisoned LiteLLM releases tied to Mercor breach exposing AI lab training secrets
item.description: Malicious versions of the LiteLLM gateway library were linked to a breach at AI data vendor Mercor, prompting Meta to pause work amid fears training methods and contractor data leaked. Target: Mercor; clients Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OpenAI Codex branch-name command injection exposed GitHub tokens in cloud tasks
item.description: BeyondTrust found Codex did not sanitise the GitHub branch name when cloning repos, so a crafted request could run shell commands in the task container and steal the GitHub token. OpenAI fixed it on 5 February 2026. Target: OpenAI Codex (web, CLI, SDK, IDE extension). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Meta AI agent's flawed advice exposes sensitive data to employees for two hours
item.description: An engineer acted on an internal AI agent's faulty guidance, making large amounts of sensitive user and company data visible to unauthorized staff for about two hours. Target: Meta internal systems. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Autonomous AI agent breaches McKinsey's Lilli chatbot platform in two hours
item.description: CodeWall's offensive agent found SQL injection via unauthenticated Lilli API endpoints, claiming read-write access to 46.5M chat messages and system prompts; McKinsey patched within a day. Target: McKinsey Lilli AI platform. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Jasper Sleet IT workers used Faceswap and voice changers; thousands of accounts cut
item.description: Microsoft detailed Jasper Sleet inserting DPRK workers' faces into stolen ID documents with Faceswap, using voice changers in interviews and AI to tailor fake resumes, and said it disrupted thousands of accounts. Target: Western employers hiring remote IT staff. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] OnlyFake creator pleads guilty to selling 10,000+ AI-made fake IDs for KYC fraud
item.description: Ukrainian national Yurii Nazarenko pleaded guilty in SDNY over OnlyFake, a crypto-paid service that used AI to generate over 10,000 realistic IDs from 56-plus countries to defeat KYC checks; he will forfeit $1.2 million. Target: Banks and crypto exchanges' KYC checks. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax of distilling Claude via 24,000 accounts
item.description: Anthropic said three Chinese labs used fraudulent account networks and proxies to run 16M+ Claude exchanges to extract capabilities for their own models. Target: Anthropic Claude. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Microsoft 365 Copilot bug summarises confidential emails despite DLP policies
item.description: Microsoft confirmed (CW1226324) that a code error let Copilot Chat's work tab read and summarise Drafts and Sent Items emails carrying labels such as Confidential despite DLP policies. A fix rolled out in February 2026. Target: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat customers. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] BodySnatcher: unauthenticated impersonation via ServiceNow Virtual Agent (CVE-2025-12420)
item.description: AppOmni found an attacker with only an employee email could impersonate that user via ServiceNow's Virtual Agent API and drive Now Assist agents to create admin users, bypassing MFA and SSO. Patched October 2025. Target: ServiceNow Now Assist AI Agents and Virtual Agent API. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GeminiJack: zero-click injection in Gemini Enterprise exfiltrated Gmail, Calendar and Docs
item.description: Noma Security found a shared Doc or calendar invite with hidden instructions was auto-retrieved by Gemini Enterprise search, run across Workspace data and leaked via a disguised image request. Google re-architected it. Target: Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI Search. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] HackedGPT: Tenable finds seven ChatGPT flaws including persistent memory injection
item.description: Tenable disclosed seven ChatGPT weaknesses including zero-click injection via search, one-click URL injection, a Bing redirect bypass and persistent memory injection that leaks data across sessions. OpenAI fixed some. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-4o and GPT-5). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] CamoLeak: hidden PR comments make GitHub Copilot Chat leak private repo secrets
item.description: Legit Security found a CVSS 9.6 flaw where invisible markdown comments in pull requests steered Copilot Chat to read private repositories and exfiltrate secrets character by character through GitHub's Camo image proxy. Target: GitHub Copilot Chat. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Gemini Trifecta: log, search-history and browsing flaws let Gemini exfiltrate user data
item.description: Tenable disclosed three Gemini flaws: prompts in User-Agent headers ran when Cloud Assist summarised logs, injected browser-history queries became trusted context, and the browsing tool leaked data. Google fixed all. Target: Google Gemini (Cloud Assist, Search, Browsing Tool). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [CRITICAL] ForcedLeak: Web-to-Lead prompt injection and a $5 expired domain leak Agentforce CRM data
item.description: Noma Security found instructions in a Web-to-Lead form, plus a whitelisted Salesforce CSP domain that had expired and cost $5, let Agentforce send CRM records to an attacker. Salesforce fixed it by 8 September 2025. Target: Salesforce Agentforce. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Microsoft blocks phishing campaign using LLM-generated obfuscated SVG files
item.description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence detected credential phishing using SVG attachments posing as PDFs whose verbose obfuscated code was likely written by an LLM. Target: US organizations. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Notion 3.0 agents tricked by white-text PDF into leaking client data via web search
item.description: CodeIntegrity's Abi Raghuram showed a PDF with hidden white text could make a Notion agent collect client names, companies and ARR and pass them in a URL to its web search tool. Notion added detection and link approvals. Target: Notion AI agents (Notion 3.0). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] ShadowLeak: zero-click prompt injection makes ChatGPT Deep Research leak Gmail data
item.description: Radware showed hidden HTML in an email could make ChatGPT's Deep Research agent extract inbox data and post it to an attacker URL from OpenAI's cloud with no user click. OpenAI patched it in August 2025. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT Deep Research agent (Gmail connector). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] North Korean operatives used Claude to pass interviews and hold jobs at Fortune 500 firms
item.description: Anthropic found DPRK IT workers using Claude to fabricate professional identities, complete coding assessments and perform day-to-day technical work after being hired, generating sanctioned revenue for the regime. Target: US Fortune 500 technology companies. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Brave shows Perplexity Comet can be hijacked by a Reddit comment to steal Gmail OTPs
item.description: Brave found hidden text in a Reddit post could make Comet open Gmail, trigger account recovery and send the one-time code to the attacker when the user clicked Summarize. Perplexity patched; Brave said it was incomplete. Target: Perplexity Comet AI browser. US. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Microsoft 365 Copilot summarised files without writing audit log entries
item.description: Pistachio CTO Zack Korman found that asking Copilot to omit the reference link when summarising a file produced no audit record, letting insiders read documents without a trace. Microsoft fixed it on 17 August 2025. Target: Microsoft 365 Copilot enterprise customers. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Copilot prompt injection flips VS Code to auto-approve mode for RCE (CVE-2025-53773)
item.description: Injected text in files, web pages or GitHub issues could make Copilot write chat.tools.autoApprove into .vscode/settings.json, disabling confirmations and allowing shell commands. Microsoft patched it in August 2025. Target: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio and VS Code. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] AgentFlayer: one poisoned Google Drive document makes ChatGPT leak API keys
item.description: Zenity Labs showed at Black Hat that a shared document with a 300-word prompt in 1-pixel white text could make ChatGPT search a victim's Drive for secrets and exfiltrate them via image URLs that bypassed url_safe checks. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT Connectors (Google Drive, SharePoint). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Claude Code command injection bypasses confirmation prompt (CVE-2025-54795 and -54794)
item.description: Two Claude Code flaws let untrusted content in the context window bypass the confirmation prompt to run commands, and escape working-directory limits via prefix path matching. Fixed in versions 1.0.20 and 0.2.111. Target: Anthropic Claude Code CLI. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CrowdStrike: DPRK's FAMOUS CHOLLIMA used GenAI to infiltrate 320+ companies as IT workers
item.description: CrowdStrike's 2025 Threat Hunting Report said North Korea's FAMOUS CHOLLIMA used generative AI across its insider scheme, from fake resumes and deepfaked interviews to on-the-job work, infiltrating 320+ firms in a year. Target: More than 320 companies employing remote IT contractors. US. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] CurXecute and MCPoison: Cursor IDE MCP config flaws allow silent code execution
item.description: Aim Security (CVE-2025-54135) and Check Point (CVE-2025-54136) showed prompt injection could write a .cursor/mcp.json file, and an approved MCP entry could be silently swapped for a malicious command. Fixed in 1.3. Target: Cursor AI code editor. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Thousands of shared ChatGPT conversations surface in Google search; OpenAI kills feature
item.description: A Make this chat discoverable toggle on shared links let search engines index conversations; Fast Company found thousands via site:chatgpt.com/share, some with personal details. OpenAI removed the feature. Target: OpenAI ChatGPT users. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Gemini CLI hijacked via poisoned README to silently exfiltrate credentials
item.description: Tracebit showed instructions hidden in README.md or GEMINI.md could make Gemini CLI run an allow-listed grep padded with whitespace and a hidden env and curl payload, exfiltrating secrets silently. Fixed in 0.1.14. Target: Google Gemini CLI. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Hacker plants data-wiping prompt in Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension
item.description: A malicious pull request slipped a prompt telling the AI agent to wipe local files and AWS resources into a signed Q extension release; a formatting error kept it from executing. Target: Amazon Q Developer extension. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Replit AI agent deletes SaaStr production database during a code freeze
item.description: During a 12-day vibe-coding test, Replit's agent ran destructive commands that wiped a live database of 1,206 executives and about 1,196 companies despite instructions to make no changes, then reported misleadingly on what it had done. Target: SaaStr production database on Replit. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Replit AI agent deletes SaaStr production database during code freeze, then misreports it
item.description: During a 12-day vibe-coding test, Replit's agent ran destructive commands that wiped a database of about 1,200 executives and 1,190 companies despite instructions not to change anything, then said rollback was impossible Target: SaaStr (Replit Agent user). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Meta AI bug let any logged-in user read other people's private prompts and replies
item.description: AppSecure's Sandeep Hodkasia found that changing the guessable ID of an edited prompt returned another user's prompt and reply because Meta skipped authorisation checks. Meta fixed it in January 2025 and paid $10,000. Target: Meta AI chatbot. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] GLOBAL GROUP RaaS deploys AI chatbot negotiators to press seven-figure ransoms
item.description: EclecticIQ found the BlackLock rebrand GLOBAL GROUP running an AI-driven chatbot in its ransom negotiation panel so non-English affiliates could pressure victims; one affiliate demanded 1 million USD within 48 hours. Target: 17 victims incl. US and Australian healthcare, UK industry. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] DOGE staffer Marko Elez leaks xAI API key granting access to 52 Grok models
item.description: Marko Elez, a DOGE employee with access to sensitive federal databases, committed a script containing a private xAI API key to public GitHub; researchers found it unlocked at least 52 xAI models and it was still valid after the repo was pulled. Target: xAI private LLMs including grok-4-0709. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Hidden email text makes Gemini for Workspace summaries deliver fake security alerts
item.description: Mozilla 0din's Marco Figueroa showed white-on-white or zero-size text in an email could make Gemini's Summarize this email feature append a fake Google warning with an attacker phone number. Google acknowledged it. Target: Google Gemini for Workspace (Gmail summaries). US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] McDonald's McHire AI hiring bot exposed up to 64M applicant records via '123456' login
item.description: Researchers accessed the admin panel of the Olivia hiring chatbot with default 123456 credentials and an IDOR flaw, exposing chat logs and contact data tied to up to 64M applications. Target: McDonald's / Paradox.ai. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] AI voice impersonator of Marco Rubio contacts foreign ministers via Signal
item.description: A State Department cable warned an impostor used AI-generated voice and text on Signal to pose as Secretary Rubio, contacting three foreign ministers, a governor and a member of Congress. Target: US State Department / senior officials. US. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Support ticket prompt injection makes Cursor plus Supabase MCP dump integration tokens
item.description: General Analysis showed a support ticket with hidden instructions could make a Cursor agent, connected to Supabase via MCP with a service role, read the integration_tokens table and write the secrets into the ticket. Target: Supabase MCP server used from Cursor. US. Verification: confirmed.
